description: Shared vectors for codepet_core::lifecycle (Rust) and qml/shared/LifeText.js. Generated by an independent Python transcription of spec §4.3. op 'advance': advance(vitals, rules, mode, delta) -> expect.{vitals, events, charged, discarded}. op 'apply_care': apply_care(vitals, rules, filled) -> expect.{vitals, events}. expect.status = status(expect.vitals); expect.windows = windows(expect.vitals, rules, mode) (armed life). Meters are hundredths (10000 = full); durations are attended ms; array order is [hunger, thirst, mental_health, hygiene]; null means none.
